product.reading: Reading the sites and the proxy's state.

events.none: No requests matched a rule in this range

traffic.title: Traffic
traffic.detectingDetail: {{detected}} requests would have been blocked in this range. Review them on Blocked, add exclusions for the false positives, then switch the site to Block under Sites.
traffic.chartDetail: Allowed, would block and blocked, stacked
traffic.recentDetail: Blocked, and what detection-only mode would have blocked

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.description: Requests a rule of the Core Rule Set or one of your own matched: blocked, would block in detection-only mode, or logged below the threshold.
blocked.search: Search IP, path, rule id or reference

rules.title: Rules (OWASP CRS)
rules.description: OWASP Core Rule Set {{crs}} in Coraza {{coraza}}. Turn a group off only when the site does not run that stack.
rules.noSitesDetail: The rule set runs per site. Add a site under Sites first.
rules.higherDetail: This site blocks. Try a higher level in detection-only mode for a week first, and watch Blocked.
rules.name: Name
rules.rulesHint: Rules that run at this site's paranoia level, of all in the group.
rules.inGroupDetail: Greyed levels do not run at this site's paranoia level.

custom.title: Custom rules
custom.description: SecLang rules run after the Core Rule Set, for one site or every site. Ids 1000000 to 1999999 are yours.
custom.name: Name
custom.seclangHint: SecRule and SecAction, phase 1 or 2, with deny to block. Rules that read files, run programs or turn the engine off are refused.
custom.patchDetail: For a flaw a DAST scan found: block one kind of attack in one parameter of one page until the code is fixed.
custom.patchInvalid: Give a path starting with / and a parameter name of letters, digits and _ . - [ ].

sites.title: Sites
sites.description: Host names the WAF answers for, and the application it passes their requests to. Each site has its own mode, rules and exclusions.
sites.addDetail: It starts in detection-only mode: requests are inspected and reported, nothing is blocked, until you switch it to Block.
sites.name: Name
sites.hostsHint: Separated by commas, without the port. * takes every host no other site has.
sites.matchedHint: Blocked and would block, over 7 days.
sites.detectingDetail_one: {{count}} request would have been blocked in the last 7 days. Review it on Blocked before switching to Block.
sites.detectingDetail_other: {{count}} requests would have been blocked in the last 7 days. Review them on Blocked before switching to Block.
sites.noneDetail: Add a site: its host names and the application behind it.
sites.how: Point your TLS proxy, or DNS, at this container's proxy port (8000 unless WAF_PROXY_PORT says otherwise) for the host names of your sites, in place of the application. Set OPENASY_TRUSTED_PROXIES to the TLS proxy's address so the client's address is the one reported.
sites.blockDetail_one: {{count}} request would have been blocked in the last 7 days. If it came from a real user, add an exclusion first.
sites.blockDetail_other: {{count}} requests would have been blocked in the last 7 days. If some came from real users, add exclusions first.
sites.deleteDetail: Its host names stop being served, and its exclusions and rules go. What it blocked stays until the retention.

exclusions.title: Exclusions
exclusions.description: Narrow exceptions for false positives. Each one weakens protection a little, so keep them narrow and remove the ones no longer needed.
exclusions.newDetail: Leave a rule, or one part of the request, out for one site, everywhere or under one path.
exclusions.reasonHint: Why this is a false positive
exclusions.ruleHint: Such as 942100, or 942000-942999 for a range
exclusions.targetHint: Such as ARGS:filter or REQUEST_HEADERS:User-Agent; empty for the whole rule
exclusions.pathHint: Such as /v1/reports; empty for the whole site

attention.downDetail: Coraza runs inside this container in front of every site. Until it is back, the sites do not answer; WAF starts it again on its own. Its logs are in the container's.
attention.notLoaded: The proxy did not take the last change; the rules before it keep serving
attention.droppedDetail: More requests matched than could be written at once, so some were counted but not kept. Requests were still blocked.

settingsPage.askAnAdmin: Ask an admin of this WAF.

account.title: Account
account.description: Your profile, password, two-step verification and where you are signed in.

members.title: Members
members.description: Who can sign in to this WAF, and with which role. Viewers see everything; editors also add exclusions and custom rules; admins also manage sites and their mode, members and tokens.

signin.title: Sign-in
signin.description: Identity providers people can sign in with, such as OpenAsy Identity, Keycloak or Microsoft Entra ID, and which of their groups give which role.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: For scripts and CI. Each token has one role and an expiry; the secret is shown once.
